insights.summary: Q4 FY26 standalone revenue rose 47% to ₹66 Cr and FY26 13% to ₹225 Cr (consolidated ₹226 Cr) at a 17% EBITDA margin, as the new alloy furnace started in Q4 and exports recovered in H2. The MD keeps FY27 guidance at 20-30% consolidated revenue growth with a 15-18% EBITDA margin; alloys should be 3-4x FY26, relays are delayed again to H2 FY27 (₹25-50 Cr possible), and rare-earth magnet sales should start in Q4 FY27 (₹10-15 Cr). Consolidated debt rose to ~₹88 Cr after a $5 million ECB for the subsidiaries' capex.
